explanation: Added the 'new' keyword to the Stripe constructor call as required by v22.0.0.
Updated the stripe.customers.retrieve call to pass the apiKey within a RequestOptions object instead of as a plain string argument.
Converted the function to async/await to replace the removed callback support in Stripe v22.0.0.
Renamed stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification according to the v19.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Updated Stripe.webhooks() to Stripe.webhooks as it is now a plain object instead of a factory function in v18.0.0.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.AlertCreateParams to match SDK version 17.0.0.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details to comply with SDK version 16.0.0.
Renamed the `listUpcomingLineItems` method on the `Invoice` resource to `listUpcomingLines` as specified in the v10.0.0 SDK changelog.
Replaced the removed `retrieveDetails` method call with a throwing Error and a TODO comment as specified for unreplaced method removals.
Updated stripe.checkoutSessions to stripe.checkout.sessions to reflect the new namespace and renamed CheckoutSession class.
Added a TODO comment above the removed expires_after field read for v22.7.0-alpha.4 and left the code to read it as undefined.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on the billing alert object to match SDK v17.0.0 changes.
Added optional chaining to offer.end_behavior.transition to safely handle the case where it is null or undefined following the v22.7.0-alpha.4 SDK update.
